instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a bright indoor study room. On the left, the woman with dark hair and glasses (R2) sits looking down at an open book, holding a pen vertically in her hand. On the right, the man with short curly blonde hair (R1) sits looking down at papers on the wooden desk. They are seated together at the table with documents, a laptop, and a glass of water. Soft natural light from the background window illuminates the quiet study session.
